finale.narration.1: This is it, Commander, the last sol! A dust storm and a freezing night are coming at the same time.
finale.narration.2: The supply ship arrives soon. All we have to do is keep the outpost running.
finale.narration.3: You have learned so much. You can do this!
finale.dialogue.kai: Our systems share power. Where should it go?
finale.dialogue.mei: Air, shield or warmth? You decide!
finale.question: How do we get through the storm?
finale.A.label: Balanced (a little to each system)
finale.B.label: Air first
finale.C.label: Shield first
finale.A.after: We shared power across the systems. Real mission planners balance competing needs too.
finale.B.after: We prioritized air. That left less power for other needs.
finale.C.after: We prioritized protection. That left less power for other needs.
finale.classroom: Which earlier decision would you change next time?
finale.dialogue.thiri: Commander, I just got your message. Your plan looks great! Earth is so proud of you.
finale.dialogue.complete: Mission complete! You kept the outpost running for 10 sols. Real mission planners balance air, power and protection just like this.
